alternative_hypothesis: A misconfigured frontend or an undocumented operational check retried connections to these destinations.

rationale: The frontend repeatedly attempted connections to three non-baseline IP addresses and directly to the database, consistent with unauthorized network probing; all were dropped. CHG-1642 covered only the database reachability check and had expired before the observation window.
